name: attestor
description: Audit-grade memory backbone for agent teams. Bi-temporal facts (event time + transaction time, with recall(as_of=...) replay), 6-step deterministic retrieval (no LLM in the critical path), conversation ingest with speaker-locked dual-pass extraction, per-tenant Postgres row-level security, and Ed25519-signed provenance. Postgres + pgvector + Neo4j defaults.
